C0120.title: Douyin Platform Crackdown on Pornographic Gambling Referral, Proxy Reporting, and Fake Traffic Leads to Arrest of 162 Suspects
C0120.summary: Douyin platform collaborated with authorities to dismantle criminal gangs, resulting in the arrest of 162 suspects. These gangs engaged in pornographic gambling referral, proxy reporting, and fake traffic generation on Douyin, exploiting fraudulent traffic for ad monetization and undermining the platform's advertising ecosystem.
